items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: We have this old Bentley... Actually it's a Vine(?) & (?) Princess in the old 1956 English limousine.

ctx.x: She's an all-around genius type, really. Anything she puts her mind to, she does very well. We have this old Bentley... Actually it's a Vine(?) & (?) Princess in the old 1956 English limousine. The history of it, it was actually in the diplomatic corps. We have some papers to prove all this. Anyhow, we are tearing all the insides out, and she is reupholstering herself, and I am doing the outside stuff.
Well, wonderful. Where did you get it? How did you get it?
